subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with prompt-driven selective reply routing left to existing message-tool policy or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The metadata omission is source-confirmed and narrow, but allowing prompts to choose delivery channels affects deterministic routing, message delivery policy, and channel/plugin contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and supported channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Track channel-selective replies separately as an explicit product/API design after the metadata gap is fixed.

options.title: Rely On Existing Routing Policy
options.body: Treat host-controlled visible replies and message-tool policy as the supported path, and close the broader selective-routing request after documenting that decision.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and supported channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared command prompt bundle history and latest maintainer scoping comment make this the clearest owner for the metadata-versus-routing decision.
